Police are now conducting an investigation to determine the cause of the incident.

articles.title: Telangana student goes missing in US, last seen leaving home for a walk
articles.summary: Sreeja Reddy Koya, a 23-year-old student from Nalgonda, is missing in Boston after taking a walk. Local police report that she was last seen near her residence at about 9.45 pm on November 2. Friends became concerned and alerted authorities after she did not return. Her phone location pointed to an area close to the beach, but she remains unaccounted for.

articles.title: ‘Legends don't say goodbye’: Ex-cricketer's tribute for Shami after retirement
articles.summary: Mohammed Shami has officially announced his retirement from Test cricket, marking the end of a distinguished twelve-year journey. Over his career, he participated in 64 Tests, claiming 229 wickets for India, with standout performances particularly against South Africa and Australia. Manoj Tiwary, his fellow cricketer, honored Shami's impact on the sport, calling him a true warrior. Shami plans to remain active in limited-overs formats.

articles.title: Ankur Warikoo shares 3 money rules he follows for his retired parents
articles.summary: Entrepreneur Ankur Warikoo shares his approach to supporting his elderly parents financially, emphasizing the blend of assistance and autonomy. He sponsors their travels to destinations they love, provides a regular monthly allowance for their expenses, and upgrades their mobile phones every two years. This balanced strategy showcases how financial help can also empower parents to maintain their independence and enjoy life.

articles.title: Ex-LA deputy gets 67 months for smuggling heroin in Pringles cans
articles.summary: Former Los Angeles County sheriff’s deputy Michael Meiser has been sentenced to 67 months in federal prison for attempting to smuggle 1.1 pounds of heroin worth approximately $226,000 into a California jail. Prosecutors said Meiser concealed the drugs inside two Pringles cans and accepted $16,500 in cash and digital payments for the smuggling operation.

articles.title: Hyderabad student builds Rs 68,000 satellite receiver for remote villages
articles.summary: Aagam Jain, a passionate student from Hyderabad, has engineered an innovative device named SummitSathi. This unique satellite receiver delivers essential weather updates without needing an internet connection, making it perfect for remote Himalayan villages. Plans are underway to introduce three units across ten villages in the Seraj Valley, significantly enhancing access to crucial weather data.

articles.title: How B'luru killer kept 10-year-old boy with him after murdering his parents
articles.summary: Indushekhar was apprehended near a photocopy shop with a 10-year-old boy, whose parents had been murdered. The boy had unknowingly spent time with the suspect, believing his parents were away. Indushekhar had planned to kill the boy too, after having taken him on a trip. The boy’s grandmother, who raised the alarm, was devastated and initially refused to eat.

On Monday, Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu will meet with union representatives to discuss these issues.

articles.title: US stocks: Wall street bounces back after hitting 18-month low as chipmakers rally

Concerns regarding potential regulatory changes in the AI industry persist, creating investor uncertainty about future market stability. Meanwhile, global markets, including European and Asian stocks, continued to experience declines over the week.

articles.title: 'Severe' season in Delhi: GRAP III in force as air quality plummets

The average AQI reached 382 at 4pm on Friday, prompting precautionary measures to be implemented. Areas throughout the city are already reporting severe air quality levels, particularly Punjabi Bagh and DTU. In response, certain restrictions on vehicles and construction activities have been enforced.

articles.title: 'Voices in head said to kill Trump': Man with firearms arrested near White House

When confronted by officers, he insisted that he heard voices commanding him to execute President Trump. A subsequent search of his stolen car revealed three guns and additional ammunition. A Venezuelan national without legal status since March 2024, Chrinos now underscores the persistent dangers faced by the president.

280 Ice Age engravings found in Spanish cave overlooked for 60 years
articles.summary: A remarkable archaeological find at Cova de la Font Major has revealed 280 Palaeolithic engravings, showcasing diverse motifs of animals and geometric shapes. This challenges the previously held notion that cave art was scarce in northeastern Iberia, where only two pieces were known. These engravings suggest the existence of unique artistic traditions independent of the famous Franco-Cantabrian region, offering new insights into the cultural practices of Ice Age Europe.

articles.title: Black grouse chicks hatch in North York Moors after nearly 200-year absence

In 2024, 20 black grouse were moved from North Pennines as part of a dedicated effort that includes habitat restoration and management of predators. Reports indicate a notable rise in the number of displaying males, with plans for further translocations underway to bolster their population even more.

articles.title: Elon Musk: Tesla to end Texas Cybertruck production to make way for Cybercab

Regulatory scrutiny is ongoing for the Cybercab, Tesla's centerpiece in its autonomous vehicle strategy. Despite the wind-down, Musk maintains that the Cybertruck was a remarkable technological achievement.

articles.title: Olympics once awarded medals for poetry; 1912 gold went to founder under 2 fake names
articles.summary: The Olympic Games once awarded gold medals for poetry, music, architecture, painting and sculpture alongside traditional sporting events. Introduced at Pierre de Coubertin’s insistence in 1912, the artistic competitions even saw the Olympic founder secretly win a literature gold medal under two assumed names. However, amateurism rules and declining interest eventually brought the unusual tradition to an end after the 1948 London Olympics.

He announced his retirement through an emotional video message to the Portuguese people, marking the end of his national career. Ronaldo holds a record of 146 international goals and significant victories, including Euro 2016 and the UEFA Nations League title.

articles.title: Bombay HC cancels Sachin Waze's bail in Antilia bomb scare case
articles.summary: The Bombay High Court has overturned the bail originally granted to Sachin Waze regarding the serious Antilia bomb scare incident. This move came after the National Investigation Agency appealed against the previous bail decision. Waze, arrested in March 2021, remains in custody as the court highlights explosive elements and security threats, raising crucial legal and investigative discussions surrounding the case.

articles.title: Jeff Bezos' ex-wife $30 mn donation gets 10 yr affordable housing plan in Bay Area
articles.summary: Housing Trust Silicon Valley has unveiled an ambitious 10-year initiative aimed at improving affordable housing in the Bay Area. With a generous $30 million backing from MacKenzie Scott, this plan seeks to bolster homeownership initiatives and forge stronger alliances with policy advocacy. The focus is on maximizing current funding and attracting new resources to create and maintain affordable housing for the community over the next decade.

articles.title: Drones carrying drones: Turkey turns Bayraktar TB2 into flying weapons carrier
articles.summary: In an innovative leap in drone technology, Turkey's Bayraktar TB2 is being engineered as a launch platform for smaller kamikaze drones. Recently, it showcased its capabilities by successfully deploying Skydagger FPV drones onto targets. This integration not only enhances the operational range of these attack drones but also allows the TB2 to act as a communications hub, potentially redefining strategic warfare through coordinated aerial strikes from a single unit.

articles.title: Iowa landlord loses $700k in alleged Ponzi scheme; $351k divorce award upheld
articles.summary: An Iowa landlord, asserting a $700,000 loss from a Ponzi scheme, sought to reduce his divorce payment but was unsuccessful. The Iowa Court of Appeals confirmed the trial court's $351,446 ruling. The husband contended his premarital assets should remain separate; however, the court determined these assets were commingled and part of the marital estate. This case emphasizes the necessity for clear marital property agreements.

articles.title: Footballer's death: Goalkeeper Owono left out of Equatorial Guinea’s AFCON squad
articles.summary: Equatorial Guinea goalkeeper Jesus Owono has been excluded from the AFCON qualifiers following the death of Jesus de Miguel. De Miguel passed away after a collision with Owono during a match, leaving many in mourning. Owono expressed deep sorrow and struggles to process the tragedy he experienced. He has faced online abuse, leading him to deactivate his social media account.

Greenpeace drops nine celebrity-signed boulders to curb North Sea fishing
articles.summary: Environmental activists from Greenpeace have deployed nine limestone boulders in the Southern North Sea to prevent bottom trawling. This underwater barrier aims to protect marine biodiversity, particularly harbour porpoises affected by industrial fishing. Greenpeace argues that government protections have been insufficient to shield marine habitats from destructive fishing methods. The deployment of boulders took place without a marine licence, raising regulatory concerns.

articles.title: Tech billionaire Kenneth Hao, wife commit $175M for healthcare transformation
articles.summary: Kenneth Hao and Kathy Chiao have generously donated $175 million to the University of California system, with the aim of modernizing medical infrastructure and enhancing healthcare technology across both human and veterinary medicine. Their pledge emphasizes the necessity for innovative facilities that foster advanced medical technologies, particularly benefiting UC San Francisco and UC Davis. Through the Hao Family Foundation, they continue to focus on impactful charitable contributions.

articles.title: Ludhiana girl, 6, holds difficult yoga pose for 18 minutes, sets record
articles.summary: At just six years old, Sarah Sangar from Ludhiana has made headlines by holding the seated wide-legged yoga pose on a gymnastics balance beam for 18 minutes and 20 seconds, setting a new record. Recognized by the India Book of Records on October 3, 2026, this accomplishment not only highlights her impressive bodily control and flexibility but also encourages children everywhere to pursue excellence in physical fitness through dedicated training.

articles.title: Ollie Watkins' wife Ellie returns to UK with kids amid Saudi security concerns
articles.summary: Ollie Watkins’ wife, Ellie, has returned to the UK with their two children months after his reported £50 million move from Aston Villa to Al-Hilal. Citing security concerns and regional conflict in Saudi Arabia, she said the family would stay in Britain until conditions improve. Watkins, meanwhile, continues his career in Riyadh, having recorded six goals and five assists in 10 appearances.

articles.title: US issues Forever stamp celebrating Diwali, features Rangoli created by Indian artist
articles.summary: In a vibrant tribute to Diwali, USPS has launched a new Forever stamp showcasing a stunning rangoli design by Sangita Bhutada. The unveiling occurred at the Embassy of India in Washington DC on October 21, marking the second issuance of a Diwali stamp since 2016. Crafted over eight to ten days with colored sand, this stamp edition comprises 20 million copies for collectors and enthusiasts alike.

articles.title: Trump's Midas curse: Why his golden picks turned blue in US midterms 2026
articles.summary: Donald Trump's endorsement of numerous candidates in the 2026 midterms proved less effective than anticipated, leading to notable electoral disappointments. Democrats triumphed in Senate and House elections, gaining ground in areas that were once Republican strongholds. The performance of Trump's endorsed candidates reflected a troubling disconnect with voters. Furthermore, Democratic success extended to gubernatorial elections and state legislatures, thereby underscoring an evolving political landscape laden with challenges for the GOP.

articles.title: Sensex settles over 2,000 points higher, investors end Rs 8 lakh cr richer: Top reasons for rally

The US midterm election results also contributed positively to market sentiment globally. Broader market indices and banking stocks joined in the rally, reflecting widespread investor confidence.

articles.title: Hardeep Singh Puri elected unopposed to Rajya Sabha from Madhya Pradesh
articles.summary: Hardeep Singh Puri was elected unopposed to the Rajya Sabha from Madhya Pradesh after other candidates failed to qualify. The nominations of Rajkumar Lohani and Kante Sayanna were rejected for not meeting necessary requirements. Puri's election follows the resignation of Union minister of state L Murugan in mid-October. Hemant Khandelwal, among other officials, was present when Puri collected his election certificate.

articles.title: The push for low-cost standoff weapons: Why air forces are turning to glide bombs
articles.summary: The US Air Force is investigating new glide bomb technologies to lower costs associated with missile-led campaigns. Current operations in prolonged conflicts have highlighted the expense of missile usage. The US military is also pursuing powered missile variants to enhance strike capabilities in various scenarios. India is developing similar glide bomb technologies aimed at increasing precision and operational range for its forces.

articles.title: Bombay HC shields Ananya Panday; platforms must erase AI images

articles.title: ‘If death is my destiny’: Sheikh Hasina firm on returning to Bangladesh in December

The former Prime Minister is aware of the risks associated with her return, including potential arrest or worse. Hasina's Awami League party has been banned, resulting in widespread political repression and violence against its members. She expressed concerns over the rising influence of extremist groups in the current political climate.

articles.title: Guitar mistaken for pillion, turban for bare head: When AI traffic cameras get it wrong

However, the technology faces significant challenges resulting in numerous erroneous challans issued to motorists. Incidents include misidentification of objects, such as guitars and turbans, as violations leading to fines. Complaints regarding the accuracy of the system have surged, highlighting accountability issues. As technology evolves, ensuring accuracy is crucial in minimizing errors encountered by drivers.

articles.title: Trump's midterm setback may ease tariff pressure on India: Report
articles.summary: The outcome of the 2026 midterm elections could significantly boost India's leverage in trade negotiations with the US. With Democrats gaining power, Trump's capacity to enforce harsh tariffs is constrained, alleviating pressure on India. This shift allows India to pursue trade agreements more strategically and carefully, potentially resulting in better deals. Furthermore, new legal constraints on Trump limit his tariff imposition options, enhancing India's prospects in upcoming trade discussions.

articles.title: Island nation’s treaty with Australia raises concerns over loss of cultural heritage

Researchers are documenting Tuvalu's architectural history through photographs and digital models. Decisions on migration and land use should integrate considerations of cultural heritage and community identity.

articles.title: Strangled after drinks, body dumped in lake: Wife, 2 lovers kill husband in Telangana

The police have arrested all three individuals and have charged them accordingly.

articles.title: Oleshky evacuees reach Ukraine after taking a detour through Russia

The perilous living conditions and food scarcity pushed these individuals to leave their homes, ultimately finding refuge in the Chernihiv region of Ukraine.

articles.title: Kim Jong Un's cyber army: How North Korea's hackers steal billions for regime

Cyber operations are essential for generating funds due to international sanctions and economic isolation. Reassured by the buyers' intention to cherish the house rather than demolish it, the couple found solace in their memories. This sale marks a poignant shift as they prepare to embrace a new chapter in Taylors Lakes.

articles.title: Greek shipwreck's 2,000-year-old device was built to predict eclipses
articles.summary: In 1900, a remarkable discovery was made when divers stumbled upon the Antikythera Mechanism amidst a shipwreck in the Mediterranean Sea. This ancient artifact showcased astounding knowledge of astronomy and mechanical engineering dating back over 2,000 years. Researchers found it capable of calculating astronomical cycles and predicting eclipses, intertwining science with the cultural tapestry of ancient Greece.

articles.title: 2,000-year-old Roman face cream found with last user's finger marks
articles.summary: In a remarkable find in 2003, archaeologists unveiled a cosmetic cream container dating back almost 2,000 years in London. Composed of animal fat, starch, and tin oxide, this ancient formula likely served as a moisturizer. Researchers painstakingly recreated the cream to explore its texture and look on the skin, shedding light on the beauty rituals of the past and our enduring human connection to history.

articles.title: Udupi man dies by suicide at govt hospital after being thrased by girlfriend's kin
